title: MaleTheme Duo #031 · 남 V자 보디빌더·블랙 스모키 윙·뱀파이어 테마·투톤 / 남 머슬 모델·아이돌 내추럴·산타 테마·무늬
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

LEFT: ONE real adult Mexican man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, smooth warm light-brown skin, a shy sweet smile, soft pastel-pink hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a copper miniature anvil, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop with a heavy rough copper a cube-shaped block hanging at its end, and two to three mixed-metal rings. Extremely long round nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Indian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, smooth warm brown skin with a soft glow, a calm gentle gaze, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on bronze chain (a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron cube-shaped block, a copper round bell, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a tin miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three rose-gold hair ornaments. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red velvet Santa hat with a white fur trim and pom-pom, white fur cuffs on both wrists, and a minimal red leopard-print velvet with white leopard-print fur trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
